about.title: I solve technical problems. Code is one of my tools.
about.lead: I’m a mechanical design engineer with about seven years of experience. I work in SolidWorks, produce technical documentation and work directly with production and clients. Today I design shower enclosures, many of them custom, each one shaped around a specific client’s situation.
about.software: In 2023 I started programming to build a website for my dad’s photography business, Fotoroman. I kept going: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL, and a project for a real client in renewable-energy advisory.
about.tools: At work, I’ve also built tools for myself and my team: an Excel VBA template that everyone on the team uses for email replies and quotes, and a SolidWorks macro that generates PNG visualisations with automatic numbering.
about.ai: More recently I’ve been building full-stack and AI projects. NEXUS is a ticketing platform with AI classification and RAG, where a human always makes the final call on what the AI suggests.
about.next: I’m looking for a role where engineering and software meet: engineering software, automation, AI or manufacturing technology. I’m based in Poznań and open to on-site, hybrid and remote work.
